leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the prepared ribosome was fairly predictable once the new goal named it, though it made progress.

arbitrary.text: The need to pair the ribosome with amino acids before placing it wasn't obvious to me, although their roles in building proteins were explained.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing the assembled cell use ATP made me curious how the next parts of the body fit together.
